# Nevatal — Full Documentation

> Nevatal is an independent AI studio building focused AI workspaces, grounded retrieval tools, learning platforms, developer utilities, and engineering projects.

---

## 1. Studio Overview

Nevatal (https://nevatal.id) is an independent AI engineering studio dedicated to building high-performance, focused software without subscription paywalls or vendor lock-in.

Key values:
- **Bring Your Own Key (BYOK)**: Privacy-first architecture where API keys and user prompts remain on the client or in ephemeral execution runtimes.
- **Craft and Performance**: Lightweight bundles, fast page loads, responsive interfaces, zero unnecessary dependencies.
- **Agent Interoperability**: First-class discovery endpoints for LLMs, autonomous web agents, and tool protocols (MCP, A2A).

---

## 2. Core Products & Services

### Nevatal Chat Workspace
- **URL**: https://chat.nevatal.id
- **Description**: An open-source AI tools hub featuring seventeen specialized utilities:
  1. Prompt Engineer: Refine and structure prompt templates.
  2. Writer & Editor: Structured copywriting and prose editing.
  3. Translator: Context-aware multi-language translation.
  4. Summarizer: Concise synthesis of lengthy articles and reports.
  5. Document Q&A: Grounded retrieval answering against uploaded PDFs and documents.
  6. Image Generation: Text-to-image prompting and visualization.
  7. Data Analysis: Code and spreadsheet evaluation.
  8. Batch Workflows: Parallel multi-item transformations.
  9. Additional reasoning, extraction, and utility modes.
- **Supported Providers**: OpenAI, Google Gemini, OpenRouter.
- **Storage Model**: Local browser storage; zero server-side credential retention.

### Courses & Education
- **URL**: https://chat.nevatal.id/courses
- **Description**: Free, practical AI education designed for engineers, creators, and analysts:
  - Prompting Fundamentals
  - Writing and Editing Workflows
  - Business Content Generation
  - Translation and Feedback Loops
  - Documents and Images with Multimodal Models
  - Data and Batch Processing Workflows

### Engineering Blog & Technical Writing
- **URL**: https://nevatal.id/blog
- **Description**: Deep-dive technical articles covering retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector similarity search, agent orchestration, and modern frontend engineering.

---

## 3. Machine-Readable Agent Endpoints & Discovery

Nevatal implements established and emerging web standards for autonomous agent discovery:

### Discovery Catalog
- **API Catalog (RFC 9727)**: `https://nevatal.id/.well-known/api-catalog`
- **Agent Card (A2A)**: `https://nevatal.id/.well-known/agent-card.json`
- **MCP Server Card**: `https://nevatal.id/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json`
- **Agent Skills Index**: `https://nevatal.id/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json`
- **Poppy Manifest**: `https://nevatal.id/.well-known/poppy.json`
- **AI Resource Directory**: `https://nevatal.id/.well-known/ai-catalog.json`

### Authentication & Authorization
- **OAuth 2.0 Protected Resource (RFC 9728)**: `https://nevatal.id/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource`
- **OAuth 2.0 Authorization Server (RFC 8414)**: `https://nevatal.id/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server`
- **OpenID Connect Configuration**: `https://nevatal.id/.well-known/openid-configuration`
- **Authentication Guide**: `https://nevatal.id/auth.md`

### Web Verification
- **HTTP Signatures Directory**: `https://nevatal.id/.well-known/http-message-signatures-directory`
- **Robots Policy**: `https://nevatal.id/robots.txt`
- **XML Sitemap**: `https://nevatal.id/sitemap.xml`

---

## 4. Agent Registration & API Invocation

Agents may register dynamically or provision credentials via the endpoints described in `https://nevatal.id/auth.md`:

```http
POST /api/v1/agent/register HTTP/1.1
Host: chat.nevatal.id
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "client_name": "AutonomousResearchAgent",
  "identity_type": "anonymous"
}
```

Authorized requests include the bearer token:
```http
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
```
